user.title: Connect your Hearth home
user.description: Hearth follows the rooms you're in. Paste your home's Hearth API key: in the Hearth app, open Settings, then Manage home.

data_description.api_key: The key your Hearth home shows once. Making a new key in the app stops the old one.
data_description.api_url: Leave as is unless you've been given a different address.

devices.title: Choose what Hearth gets
devices.description: Choose the thermostat Hearth runs and the room sensors it follows. You can change both later.

data_description.thermostat: The thermostat Home Assistant controls. Hearth sets its mode and temperatures from the rooms you choose.
data_description.sensors: Up to 10. Humidity and battery on the same device come along. Add each one to a room in the Hearth app.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your Hearth API key
reauth_confirm.description: Hearth no longer accepts the key. Paste the home's current key from the Hearth app (Settings, then Manage home).

data_description.api_key: The home's current key, from the Hearth app (Settings, then Manage home). Making a new key in the app stops the old one.

reconfigure.title: Update your Hearth connection
reconfigure.description: Paste the home's current Hearth API key (Hearth app: Settings, then Manage home).

data_description.api_key: The key your Hearth home shows once. Making a new key in the app stops the old one.
data_description.api_url: Leave as is unless you've been given a different address.

error.invalid_auth: Hearth didn't accept that key. Copy the current key from the Hearth app.
error.demo_home: That key belongs to a demo home, which runs on a simulated thermostat. Connect a real home first.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Hearth. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.nothing_chosen: Choose a thermostat, room sensors, or both.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Hearth is already set up. Each Home Assistant connects one Hearth home.

data_description.thermostat: The thermostat Home Assistant controls. Hearth sets its mode and temperatures from the rooms you choose.
data_description.sensors: Up to 10. Humidity and battery on the same device come along. Add each one to a room in the Hearth app.

error.nothing_chosen: Choose a thermostat, room sensors, or both.

auth_failed.message: Hearth didn't accept the API key. Reauthenticate with the home's current key from the Hearth app.
